ingress.title: Ingress routing
ingress.desc: Configure hostname → local-service forwarding rules. Changes are made to the tunnel config in Cloudflare (via login credentials). You also need a DNS route (Tunnels tab) for requests to reach the tunnel.
ingress.hostHeaderTip: Set localhost to fix "Invalid Host header" from the backend; leave empty to keep original Host
ingress.saveConfirm: Save these rules to the Cloudflare cloud? If the tunnel is running, the plugin will restart it to apply the new config.
ingress.savedRestarted: Ingress saved; tunnel restarted and applied
ingress.savedNoRestart: Ingress saved, but tunnel restart failed (restart manually if the tunnel is running):
ingress.empty: No rules yet. Click "Add rule" to start.
ingress.tip: Rules match top-to-bottom, first hit wins. The last rule must have an empty hostname (e.g. http_status:404).
ingress.noTunnels: No named tunnels yet — create one on the Tunnels tab first.
ingress.needLogin: Please log in to Cloudflare first (Environment → Open login page).
quick.title: Quick Tunnel (temporary public URL)
quick.desc: No login required — get a temporary trycloudflare.com URL instantly. Good for demos and debugging; the URL dies when stopped.
quick.hostTip: Set localhost to fix "Invalid Host header" from the backend; a domain or URL also works (hostname is extracted)
quick.confirm: Starting a quick tunnel exposes your local port to the public internet. Continue?
quick.disclaimer: The temporary URL is assigned by Cloudflare and cannot be customized.
config.title: config.yml
config.desc: Local config file for named tunnels, usually at ~/.cloudflared/config.yml. Restart running tunnels after editing.
config.empty: (file is empty or does not exist)
config.confirm: Overwrite config.yml? Back up the existing content first.
cheatsheet.title: Command cheat sheet & safe executor
cheatsheet.desc: Common cloudflared commands. Execution uses an argv array (no shell) with time/output limits; write/delete/expose commands still require a second confirmation.
cheatsheet.confirmRun: This command may change system or network state. Continue?
about.title: About this plugin
about.desc: This plugin manages Cloudflare Tunnels through the local cloudflared CLI. All write operations require a second confirmation, including Agent tool calls. Credentials stay in the system credential vault, never in config files.
